content: Isra7eele Olanchchata Kaaleththizayta

Bantta butten butten layth kumeth aginan aginan kawozasinne deraas taran taran ooththiza Isra7eele keeththa asata halaqati, shaalaqatinne mato halaqati, ola gadawati hayssafe kaallizayta; issi issi butten 24,000 asi dees.
Koyro aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Zabdi7eele naa Yashobi7aame; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Yashobi7aamey Paareese zare; izi koyro aginan olas ke7iza halaqatas gadawa.
Nam7anththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Ahihohe dere as Doodeya; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees; ha butteza izappe garsara kaaleththizay Miqiloote.
Heedzdzanththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey qeese Yoodahe naa Bannaya; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Bannayay 30 asatappe aadhdhi erettida mino as gidida gishshas izi istta bolla halaqa gidides; iza naa Amizabaadey izappe garsara azazizaade gidides.
Oydanththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Iyo7aabe isha Asaheele; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees; izasohon alaafetiday iza naa Zabaadiya.
Ichchashanththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Yixira as Shamihuute; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Usuppunththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Tequhe as Iqesha naa Ira; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Laappunththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Efreeme zareppe Piloone dere as Heleexe; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Osppunththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Huushe as Sibikaye; izi Zaraahe zareppe yides; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Uddufunththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Biniyaame zareppe Anatoote as Abi7eezere; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Tammanththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Zaraahe zareppe Naxoofe dere as Mahiraye; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Tammanne issinththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Efreeme zareppe Piraatoone as Bannaya; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Tammanne nam7anththo aginan ooththiza buttezas alaafey Otin7eele zareppe Naxoofe dere as Heldaye; iza buttezan 24,000 asi dees.
Isra7eele Asaa Garsan Qommota Qommota Kaaleththiza Ola Gadawata
Isra7eele asaa garsan qommota qommota bolla shuumettida ola gadawati hayssafe kaallidi xaafettidayta.

content.text: Yordaanoose shaafappe arshey wulliza baggan diza Minaase qommo baggata bolla summiday Paddaya naa Iyu7eele.

content: Yordaanoose shaafappe arshey mokkiza baggan Gala7aaden diza Minaase qommo baggata bolla summiday Zakaraasa naa Iddo. Biniyaame qommo bolla summiday Abineere naa Ya7isi7eele.
Daane qommo bolla summiday Yirohaame naa Azari7eele. Hayti Isra7eele asaa garsan qommota qommota kaaleththiza ola gadawata.
GODAY, «Tani Isra7eele asaa salo xoolintte mala corasana» giidi hidota qaala immida gishshas Dawiti nam7u tammanne hessafe garsara gidida asaa qoodibeenna.
Xuriya naa Iyo7aabey asaa qooda doommides shin polibeenna; asaa qoodida gaason GODAY Isra7eele asaa bolla hanqettides; hessa gishshas istta qooday Kawo Dawite taarike mazgaban xaafettibeenna.
Kawo Aqota Bolla Aawateththan Summidayta
Kawo keeththan buqura woththiza minjja keeththa alaafey Adi7eele naa Azimoote. Gaxaretan, katamatan, mooththataninne naageso miixatan diza minjja keeththata alaafey Ooziya naa Yoonataane.
Goshshanchchata alaafey Kaalube naa Eezire.
Woyne mith tokkizasohota alaafey Eramaate dere as Shim7e; woyne ushshu minjjizasota alaafey Shafaame dere as Zabde.

Shaara menththotan zumbullata xaphon diza wogara miththinne wola miththata naaganaas alaafeteththi Gadeere dere as Ba7aali-Hanaanes imettides; zayte minjjiza keeththa alaafeteththi Iyo7aasas imettides.
Lasharoone demban heemettiza wude meheta alaafeteththi Saaroone as Shiixirayas imettides; shoobban heemettiza wude meheta alaafeteththi Adilaya naa Saafaaxes imettides.
Gaamellata bolla alaafeteththi Isma7eele as Obilas imettides. Hareta bolla alaafeteththi Meronoote as Yehidayes imettides.
Dorsa wudetanne deysha wudeta naagana alaafeteththi Aggaari zareppe gidida Yaazizes imettides; hayti ubbay kawo Dawite aqota naaganaas alaafeteth ekkida.
Kawo Dawite Zorizayta
Dawite aawaa ishay Yoonataaney xaafe, akeekanchcha asanne zoriza asa; Hakimoone naa Yihi7eeley kawo nayta dichchizaade.
Akxofeeley qasse kawoza zorizaade; Arkke dere as Hushey kawos siiqo lagge.
Akxofeeleppe guye Bannaya naa Yoodaheynne Abiyaataarey kawo zoranchcha gidida; Iyo7aabey kawo olanchchata halaqatas gadawa gidides.
